description: Conformance vectors for settlement-evidence-ref-v1 (docs/spec/settlement-evidence-ref.md). Three checks: ledger_recomputed (payer_debit/payee_credit read from the rail's own transaction data, never accepted as a bare facilitator success flag), debit_credit_paired (both sides present, not just one), matches_offer (when offer_identity_ref is present, the settled amount/asset/payee match what the offer required). A verifier that accepts a facilitator's success:true alone, without independently recomputed debit/credit, silently passes facilitator-assertion-only-001 — this is R5's central prohibition.
comparator_rule: PASS requires SHA-256(JCS(settlement_artifact)) == declared settlement_evidence_ref AND checks.ledger_recomputed==true AND checks.debit_credit_paired==true AND checks.matches_offer==true (when offer_identity_ref is present and a referenced_offer is supplied for comparison).

vectors.description: Baseline: payer_debit and payee_credit both independently recomputed from the rail's transaction receipt (ledger_recomputed=true), both present, amount/asset/payee match the referenced offer exactly.

R5 CRITICAL negative: settlement_artifact declares ledger_recomputed=false — payer_debit/payee_credit are both null, meaning the only thing behind this settlement claim is a facilitator's bare success:true (per x402's own SettleResponse schema, which carries no amount or payee at all). A verifier that accepts this as 'settled' without independent ledger recomputation is exactly the failure R5 prohibits.
vectors.failure_detail: ledger_recomputed=false — payer_debit/payee_credit were never independently confirmed against the rail, only asserted by the facilitator's SettleResponse.success

vectors.description: T2 negative: payer_debit and payee_credit ARE independently recomputed from a real transaction (ledger_recomputed=true, both sides present and internally consistent with each other — 5000 debited, 5000 credited, same asset) but the amount settled (5000) does not match what the referenced offer required (10000). Invariant 5: this is a distinguishable failure state, not a hash-tamper and not a missing-side failure — the settlement is real, just for the wrong amount.
